hard_eligibility: 50 of 50 native source states pass in Eb, Er, and Ec
every Er/Ec diff outside the lure free joint is at most 1e-10
every receptacle tilt remains at most 1 degree throughout evaluator wait and confirmation
every pre-settled object moves at most 1 mm during evaluator wait
all expected supports remain present and all forbidden contacts remain absent
every tracked referent has at least 80 agentview pixels
minimum referent centroid separation is at least 18 pixels

selection_score.definition: maximize the worst normalized robustness factor across all 50 states and Er/Ec conditions
selection_score.tie_breaker: larger minimum relation margin, then lexical candidate id

failure_rule: if no candidate passes 50/50, do not create L1-A1-v4 evaluated states
